game.core.rules.readable.title: Inventory, Equipment, and Carrying
game.core.rules.readable.summary: Inventory records ownership and containment, equipment records how an item is used, and carrying capacity is projected from the character's recorded Strength and size.

blocks.heading: Three distinct records
items: Inventory identifies an item instance, its quantity, and its container path.
Equipment state identifies whether and how a carried item is equipped.
Carrying capacity compares supported carried weight with the character's recorded capacity.

blocks.heading: Containers preserve identity
blocks.body: Moving an item into a container changes containment state; it does not turn the item into descriptive text or a different definition.

examples.title: Backpack contents
examples.body: A backpack can contain item instances. Opening it reads the recorded child page while retaining each item's definition and quantity.
